title: Weekly digest email (2 of 2): where you choose what goes under the photo
question: Thanks: the dates will show as the dateline (A). Now, where you choose it in the digest. In every sketch the choice appears only once a photo is chosen; with no photo, the email always starts with the title and dates, so it never starts with nothing naming it. Pick a layout. My recommendation: F. One choice of three, each saying when you'd want it, right under the photo it depends on, using the same radio rows as other settings in the admin panel.

options.label: F: Three choices under the photo
options.thesis: 'Under the photo' straight after the photo, as three radio rows: The title and the dates, Just the dates, Nothing, each with a line saying when to use it.
options.viewport: Email tab: the photo, Under the photo with three rows, then the email preview.
options.risk: Takes about 180px, pushing the preview down a little.

options.label: G: Two switches
options.thesis: Show the title and Show the dates, as two switches under the photo, as your ticket put it.
options.viewport: Email tab: the photo, two switches, then the email preview.
options.risk: Title on with dates off isn't a real choice (the title band always has the dates), so the dates switch has to grey out or hide while the title is on.

options.label: H: A 'Top of the email' box
options.thesis: The photo and the choice together in one ruled box, the choice as three radio buttons on one line.
options.viewport: Email tab: a Top of the email box with the photo and Under the photo, then the email preview.
options.risk: A box around two things is more frame than the page needs; the short labels say less.
